hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); case "$cmd" in *'git commit'*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; case "$cmd" in *--amend*) exit 0;; esac; [ -n "$(git status --porcelain -- log.md)" ] && exit 0; printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Docs not updated for this commit. Before committing: append a dated entry to log.md (append-only, never edit old entries); refresh the progress.md snapshot in place (current state, verified items, decisions, next candidates); update feature_list.md statuses and known limitations if features changed. Update README.md only if this commit makes it factually wrong. Stage the updated docs so they land in the same commit, then re-run git commit."}}'
hooks.statusMessage: Checking that project docs are updated before commit
